supply_limits.USB_VBUS: sense+ESD only; must never connect to V5 or V3V3
supply_limits.no_external_backfeed: SWD and headers are reference outputs only; probe Vtarget must sense, not power; TLV755 has no reverse blocking
supply_limits.current_budget_revision: Final normal150mA/Ta0-40C supersedes initial120mA/Ta0-50C after MCU50mA+CAN60mA+external10mA leaves no pullup margin. Fault180mA not normal guarantee.
supply_limits.native_historical_L1_requirement: L1 saved REQUIREMENTS still says covers nominal120mA as original design context; not inductor current rating. Actual Isat5.8A/Irms4.5A unchanged and final150mA load/thermal review controls. No native rerun needed.

normal_current_budget_mA.note: Reserve rows are design allocations, not quoted IC specifications; CAN term load already included in transceiver ICC, not double-added.

unpopulated_or_rejected.input_TVS: No populated TVS: ST SMBJ16A VRWM16V but Vcl26V at10/1000us and34.4V at8/20us; latter exceeds TPS54202 abs30V. Not a surge-certified input. Optional review pads only if root explicitly adds DNP.
unpopulated_or_rejected.CAN_TVS: No arbitrary SM712/24V TVS: TCAN332 bus abs +/-14V. Short nonautomotive bench, internal device IEC12kV ESD rating does not prove system compliance.
unpopulated_or_rejected.ferrite: No default series ferrite/LC on whole V3V3; MCU analog RC supply review delegated to MCU lesson; verify DC drop/damping and supply ramp if added.
unpopulated_or_rejected.BSS84: Replaced by DMP2035U with Rds guarantee at-2.5V; BSS84 current catalog Not for Design In and no low-Vgs Rds guarantee used here.
